## AI Studio
On-brand product creative
[ Explore AI Studio ↗ ](https://www.gotolstoy.com/product/ai-studio)
![AI Studio catalog content generation workspace](https://www.gotolstoy.com/_astro/688c919b96bba036056ea6c4_home_ai-studio-3_Z2e0b3c.webp)
### Make every asset unmistakably yours
Brand DNA gives the agent your voice, visual identity, audience, products, and creative references, so every image and video starts on-brand.
![AI Studio templates creating campaign-ready product content](https://www.gotolstoy.com/_astro/68b055d21c494578b61c052d_ai-studio-2_Z21YKwJ.webp)
### Turn winning formats into reusable templates
Start with a proven creative format, swap in any product, and make campaign-ready variations without rebuilding the concept.
![AI Studio generating on-brand content across an entire product catalog](https://www.gotolstoy.com/_astro/688c919b96bba036056ea6c4_home_ai-studio-3_Z2e0b3c.webp)
### Give every SKU fresh creative
Generate product-specific images and videos across your catalog without planning a separate shoot for every item.
## AI Sales Agent
Catalog-trained guidance
[ Explore AI Sales Agent ↗ ](https://www.gotolstoy.com/product/ai-shopper)
![Virtual try-on showing a product worn by the shopper](https://www.gotolstoy.com/_astro/688c98a44560b98403f159ba_ai-shopper_ai-shopper-3_1tOKPO.webp)
### Let shoppers see themselves in the product
Virtual try-on helps shoppers compare options on their own image before they choose.
![AI Sales Agent chat answering a shopper's question on a storefront](https://www.gotolstoy.com/_astro/689094152ae78e79eb21e1d0_tolstoy_ai-shopper_ai-shopper-1_fPyvz.webp)
### Answer the questions holding up the purchase
Use your catalog to explain fit, features, and differences, then recommend the best match.
![AI Sales Agent collecting subscribers and building rich customer profiles](https://www.gotolstoy.com/_astro/688c92fd0ace84bf6422430b_home_ai-shopper-3_Z391Ri.webp)
### Learn what shoppers want from every conversation
Turn questions, preferences, and purchase intent into structured customer data your team can use across recommendations, CRM, and lifecycle marketing.

## Questions about the AI ecommerce platform
Start with the product job you need today, then connect the rest of the platform when you are ready. 
What is Tolstoy?
Tolstoy is an AI ecommerce platform for commerce brands. It brings AI product content, shoppable video, onsite shopping experiences, and an AI shopping assistant into one connected workflow.
Who is Tolstoy for?
Tolstoy is built for ecommerce teams that want to create more product content, make their storefront more useful, and help shoppers choose the right products without adding separate tools for every step.
Does Tolstoy work with Shopify?
Yes. Connect your Shopify store to bring product and catalog context into Tolstoy, then create content, publish shoppable experiences, and guide shoppers across your storefront.
How do AI Studio, AI Player, and AI Sales Agent work together?
AI Studio creates product images and videos. AI Player publishes that content as shoppable video, galleries, stories, and widgets. AI Sales Agent uses your catalog and customer context to answer questions and recommend products.
Can I start with one Tolstoy product?
Yes. You can start with AI Studio, AI Player, or AI Sales Agent based on the job you need to solve, then connect more of the platform as your workflow grows.
